method: Built-in image generation; new complete sprites, reference used for style only.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: NEW production game sprite sheet, not a screenshot or an extraction. The attached image is STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY. Generate all pixels anew. Match its charming chunky 16-bit pixel art, dark navy 1-2 pixel outlines, simple square faces and warm/cool limited palette. Real transparent alpha background. No environment, pedestal, ground, shadow disc, labels, grid lines, hearts or extra props. No baked dithering, noise, patterned overlay, gradients, glow or light beam: those are rendered later. Exactly 4 complete whole-character chronological animation frames in a regular 2 columns by 2 rows grid on a 1024x1024 transparent canvas. Every cell is 512x512, feet registration centered at x=256,y=454 relative to its cell. Keep proportions, equipment and framing consistent; do not change sprite size between frames. Entire character and accessories fit between x=60..452 and y=55..454 within every cell; plenty of empty transparent padding. Crisp square pixel clusters, target approximately 64-pixel-tall game sprite enlarged uniformly for this sheet. Frame 1 top-left: neutral standing, friendly eyes open. Frame 2 top-right: idle blink, same standing silhouette, eyelids closed. Frame 3 bottom-left: happy dance pose leaning slightly left, left foot planted, other foot raised, arms/wings spread with delight. Frame 4 bottom-right: complementary happy dance leaning right, right foot planted and other foot raised, joyful expression. Whole character in EVERY frame, nothing detached, no anatomical missing parts. Dance poses can change silhouette naturally but share identical torso size and planted-ground baseline. CHARACTER: friendly green Cthulhu as in B, blocky mint-green square head, two cream square eyes, short dangling tentacles, two small bat wings, blue-and-yellow Swedish knitted scarf, short green legs. Clearly a cute chthonic sea god, not a Norse god. Preserve the specific scarf, wings, square head and tentacles from the design.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production 2D pixel-art robot animation sprite sheet. Attached B scene is style reference ONLY, not an edit target; do not cut/copy scene fragments. A tiny mint-green friendly AI helper with squat rectangular body/head, square dark navy face window, two square cream eyes, a small block antenna, two block arms and two short visible feet, simple chest dot. Match B's chunky 16-bit proportions and strong dark navy outline. Solid 3-tone mint body shading, cream eyes and navy outlines; no dithering, noise, glows, texture filters, shadows or environment. Genuine transparent alpha. Exactly 8 complete whole-character frames in a regular 4 columns × 2 rows grid, on a 1536×1024 sheet. Every cell 384×512. All complete frames share same torso scale and center x=192, planted ground y=450. Leave at least 50px transparent margin on each side of each cell. Read left to right: top row 1 neutral standing, 2 blink same pose, 3 walk left-leg forward/right-leg back contact, 4 walk passing pose left planted/right lifted. Bottom row 5 opposite walk contact right-leg forward/left back, 6 opposite passing pose right planted/left lifted, 7 delighted dance leaning left arms up, 8 delighted dance leaning right arms up. Walking feet and arms must visibly alternate, all eyes/antenna/chest details stay identical. Front-facing slight 3/4-down game view as reference; do not turn around. No grids, labels, numbers, hearts or extra objects; every pose is the WHOLE robot, not detached pieces.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production 2D pixel-art white bunny animation sprite sheet. Attached B scene is visual style reference ONLY; generate all pixels newly, do not extract scene fragments. Same cute small ivory rabbit with two tall pink-centered ears, small dark square eye, tiny pink nose, round blocky body, little feet and fluffy tail, facing right in every frame. Strong dark navy outline, ivory/cream solid shade clusters, match B's chunky 16-bit pixel scale. No dithering, noise, glows, gradients, shadows, fence or ground. Genuine transparent alpha. Exactly 8 complete whole-bunny frames on a regular 4 columns × 2 rows grid on a 1536×1024 sheet; every cell 384×512 with consistent body scale and center, planted feet baseline y=440; at least 50px transparent margin around each sprite. Top row left to right: 1 relaxed sitting alert, 2 nose forward sniffing ears slightly tilted, 3 munching with head gently down, 4 grooming front paw raised to face. Bottom row: 5 hop launch with rear legs tucked, 6 mid-hop stretched body with feet extended, 7 sleeping curled with eyes closed and relaxed ears, 8 delighted binky with ears flopping and happy eyes. Keep complete ears, feet, tail and torso inside each cell. No detached parts, no labels/grid lines or scene fragments. The same identifiable bunny throughout.

animation.gods: 2×2 complete frames: neutral, blink, left dance, right dance
animation.robot: 4×2 complete frames: idle, blink, four walk poses, two dance poses
